evidence.observation: "The milestone is complete when, on main after merge:"

evidence.location: line 7 and Verification and scope, line 35
evidence.observation: "The r3 requirement to verify closure on GND main remains pending." and "The close panel and GND merge are pending."

concerns.recommendation: Record the on-main verification as an explicit post-merge gate — what is re-run (e.g., the combined focused gate at the merged main commit), who runs and records it — and word the close ruling as conditional on it, so the milestone cannot be recorded closed while its own completion condition is unmet and ungated.
concerns.title: Close requested while the plan's on-main completion condition is pending with no recorded verification gate

evidence.location: row 'Predicate 5 used GND diff for restored identity'
evidence.observation: "The 38 admitted round trips restore the expected documents. GND diff compares the 34 non-temporal models. The other four are compared directly as authored documents." — no reason is given, and the cited 020-phase-OS3.md states the same substitution without explaining why gnd diff cannot run on temporal models.

concerns.recommendation: State in the amendment (or the OS3 record) why gnd diff is inapplicable to the four temporal models — e.g., a pre-existing gnd diff limitation — so the substitution reads as an instrument limit rather than a possibly selective weakening of the predicate 5 identity check.
concerns.title: Round-trip identity check replaced by direct comparison for four temporal models without a stated reason

evidence.observation: "The full page-policy suite still reports a pre-existing paragraph-length failure in `grow-a-model.md`."

concerns.recommendation: Cite the record showing the failure predates this branch (a main-branch or pre-OS5 page-policy run), or reword to an unfalsified claim such as 'a paragraph-length failure in grow-a-model.md outside this milestone's pages, not shown to be introduced by it', so the close ruling does not rest on an unverifiable assertion.
concerns.title: 'Pre-existing' page-policy failure asserted without a cited record

response.summary: All three digests match. The candidate and the amendment account for all nine r3 exit predicates with internally consistent arithmetic (41=38+3 roster, 30+8=38 round trips, 34+4=38 identity checks, 36+2=38 conversions), and both refuted premises — universal pinned conversion (predicate 6) and per-kind semantic controls (predicate 4) — are recorded explicitly with evidence records; spot-checks against 020-phase-OS3.md, 021-phase-OS4.md and 030-phase-OS6.md corroborate the round-trip, consumer-refutation and upstream-emission claims, including the pinned pins and the PR #162 end state for predicate 9. The carried open questions (value-tuple source emission, two converter refusals) are recorded as carries, consistent with the plan. Three concerns remain, none a blocking-severity software defect: the plan's on-main completion condition is pending without a recorded verification gate, the four temporal round trips substitute direct comparison for gnd diff without a stated reason, and the 'pre-existing' page-policy failure is asserted without a cited record.
